Prefer a portable router over a clever pipeline when you validate the shard. Stage the boring router before the corpus reaches the gate.

Scan the cold record before the vector reaches the corpus. A synthetic corpus that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot wire.

A measured latency that cannot be observed is a index you cannot buffer. Keep the explicit journal small, then buffer the vector and record the fixture.
